eligible_pool_preconditions: independent curator has assigned exactly one frozen stratum before candidate predictions
rights/source/version/content hashes and curator assignment receipts are bound
no ORION/baseline prediction or outcome is present
allocation_key: SHA256('A3-ALLOCATION-V1|' + stratum + '|' + cluster_id + '|' + source_family_id + '|' + normalized_organization_lineage + '|' + artifact_lineage_id)
algorithm: within each stratum sort eligible candidates by allocation_key ascending then cluster_id
scan in order and select 24 primary candidates whose source_family_id, normalized_organization_lineage and artifact_lineage_id are each unique among all selected candidates
continue scanning remaining candidates and select 8 replication candidates with the same uniqueness rule, therefore source/org/artifact-disjoint from primary
do not substitute candidates across strata
do not manually rebalance after protected outcomes
